title: Kagamine Rin — Coloring SEKAI〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: The Way I Played That Day

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI
Lake

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting, Rin.
I brought those pencils and sketchbooks I said I'd bring the other day.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay...
But how exactly do you do still-life drawings?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Umm...
Actually, Rin, can you guess what that involves?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Drawing what you see.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Exactly. Your goal is to carefully observe your model and capture its shape, texture and such in your drawing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: However, Rin, you'll just be doing a sketch now and coloring it in later.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Your sketch will turn out better if you make sure not to press down too hard with your pencils or make the lines too thick.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, I'll be careful...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: In any case, actually drawing is the best way to learn, so let's get started.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Feel free to ask me any questions you have. I'll try to give you whatever advice I can while drawing alongside you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, let's begin with your overall composition.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I know what that is...
You're always trying to fix your drawings because of it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's because I keep thinking it'll make my drawings look better if I do. But I always obsess over it too much and end up torturing myself instead.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, this isn't as hard as you make it seem?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hmm...
I think that depends on who you ask...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: For now, why don't we decide what's going to be at the very center of your drawing?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The very center?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, whatever's gonna sit in the middle.
The thing you want to draw the most.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The thing I want to draw the most...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, the door...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Really? Sounds good.
Next, what sort of angle do you wanna draw the door from.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You could look at it straight on, from the left or from the right... It could look drastically different depending on which angle you choose.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hmm...
I think I wanna include some of the stepping stones leading up to it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay. Then, why don't we try walking around to find a good angle that includes them?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You could also go a little further by considering the height from which you draw.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: There's so much to think about...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
This is like the bare minimum.
Anyway, if you don't hurry, I'm gonna find the better spot.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, that's not happening...
The next day

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh... I drew it too big again...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Things in the distance need to be smaller...
se_walk_women_001_2
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How's your drawing coming along, Rin...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
So, I've drawn the lake...
But I'm having trouble with the things sticking out of it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I redrew them over and over.
My paper's a mess now...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But the ones on the right look really good...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku, Len, wanna try drawing something...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Us?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wow... Thanks, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Luka, move...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Phew...
My second one's finished.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It looks a lot better than the one I drew with Ena.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Still, the things up close and far away look kinda funny...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I should practice some more.
I still have plenty of pages left in this sketchbook...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wonder if Ena also thinks about this stuff while working on her drawings...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is that why she always looks so serious or like she's in pain...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Ena cares a lot more about what she draws compared to me.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (But I think I understand how she feels a little better now...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'll try drawing a third one.
